opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship (2027 cycle)

amount.raw: a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000 (plus a £1,000 financial incentive to part cover replacement labour cost)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig for 2027); not open to those in full-time education or for further research projects.
opportunities.summary: Fully funded 30-day study tour (June/July) for young people aged 18-24, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network. Includes all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, Nuffield Farming Associate membership, and a £1,000 incentive towards replacement labour. The 2027 cycle plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
